enonce.texte:
Complete the sentences using the past perfect form of the verbs in parentheses.

1. When I arrived at the station, the train _______ (leave).

2. She _______ (never / see) such a beautiful sunset before.

3. They _______ (already / eat) when we invited them to dinner.

4. He was tired because he _______ (work) all day.

5. I _______ (finish) my homework before my mother came home.

questions.texte: Fill in the blanks with the past perfect form.
questions.reponse: 1. had left, 2. had never seen, 3. had already eaten, 4. had worked, 5. had finished

enonce.texte:
Complete the sentences using the future perfect form of the verbs in parentheses.

1. By next year, I _______ (graduate) from university.

2. She _______ (finish) the report by 5 p.m.

3. They _______ (build) the new bridge by 2028.

4. We _______ (save) enough money for the trip by then.

5. He _______ (work) here for ten years by next month.

questions.texte: Fill in the blanks with the future perfect form.
questions.reponse: 1. will have graduated, 2. will have finished, 3. will have built, 4. will have saved, 5. will have worked

intitule: Past Perfect vs Past Simple - Story Completion

enonce.texte:
Read the story and fill in the blanks with the correct form: past simple or past perfect.

When I _______ (arrive) at the party, everyone _______ (already / leave). I _______ (be) disappointed because I _______ (want) to see my friends. I _______ (call) my friend Paul. He _______ (tell) me that they _______ (go) to a restaurant. I _______ (decide) to join them there.

questions.texte: Complete the story with the correct verb forms.
questions.reponse: arrived, had already left, was, had wanted, called, told, had gone, decided

enonce.texte: Write a short story (8-10 sentences) about a day something unexpected happened. Use the past perfect at least three times to describe events that happened before the main event.

questions.texte: Write a narrative using past perfect and past simple.
questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
Yesterday was a terrible day. I had woken up late because my alarm clock hadn't rung. By the time I had taken a shower, I had already missed my bus. I had never felt so stressed before. When I finally arrived at the office, my boss had already started the meeting. I had forgotten my laptop at home. I had worked on the presentation for weeks, but I couldn't show it. My colleague had saved a copy on his computer. Fortunately, he had prepared a backup for emergencies. I was so relieved.

enonce.texte:
Rewrite the sentences using future perfect.

1. The construction will be completed by the end of the year.

2. The company will move to a new office before 2027.

3. The students will finish their exams by Friday.

4. I will eat dinner before you arrive.

5. The repairs will be done by next week.

questions.texte: Rewrite each sentence using future perfect.
questions.reponse: 1. They will have completed the construction by the end of the year. 2. The company will have moved to a new office by 2027. 3. The students will have finished their exams by Friday. 4. I will have eaten dinner before you arrive. 5. They will have done the repairs by next week.

enonce.texte:
Read the following events and write a coherent narrative using the appropriate sequence of tenses (past simple, past perfect, and future perfect where appropriate).

Events (in chronological order):

1. I graduate from university in 2025.

2. I apply for a job at a multinational company.

3. I am hired and move to Douala.

4. I work for the company for 10 years.

5. I become a department manager.

questions.texte: Write a narrative using appropriate tenses.
questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
I graduated from university in 2025. After I had applied for a job at a multinational company, I was hired and moved to Douala. By the time I had worked for the company for ten years, I had become a department manager. By 2035, I will have been promoted to a director position.

enonce.texte:
Read the sentences. Write True or False based on the use of past perfect.

1. "I had eaten breakfast before I went to school." The action of eating happened first.

2. "She had left when I arrived." She left after I arrived.

3. "He had finished his work, so he went home." He finished his work before he went home.

4. "They had never visited Paris before." They visited Paris before.

5. "We had known each other for years before we started dating." They started dating before they knew each other.

questions.texte: Answer True or False for each sentence.

enonce.texte:
Choose the correct form to complete each sentence.

1. By 2030, I _______ for this company for 20 years.

2. The movie _______ by the time we arrive.

3. She _______ her degree by next summer.

questions.texte: Select the correct future perfect form.
questions.reponse: 1. will have worked, 2. will have started, 3. will have completed

intitule: Life Story - Using Past and Future Perfect

enonce.texte: Write your life story so far and your future plans. Include at least three past perfect sentences and three future perfect sentences.

questions.texte: Write about your life and future plans.
questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
I was born in Bafoussam. Before I started school, I had already learned to read with my mother. I had finished primary school by the age of 12. After I had graduated from high school, I moved to Yaoundé for university. Now, I am studying English. By the time I finish my studies, I will have lived in Yaoundé for four years. I hope that by 2030, I will have started my own business. By the time I am 30, I will have travelled to at least five countries.

intitule: Error Correction - Past and Future Perfect

enonce.texte:
Identify and correct the errors in the following sentences.

2. By next year, she will have finish her studies.

3. They had ate dinner when I arrived.

4. He will have been worked here for five years by 2025.

5. We had saw that movie before.

questions.reponse: 1. I had gone to the store before I came home. 2. By next year, she will have finished her studies. 3. They had eaten dinner when I arrived. 4. He will have worked here for five years by 2025. 5. We had seen that movie before.
